item.title: Remembering 9/11. And, Vance, Trump urge voters to back Republicans in the midterms
item.description: NPR reflects on the events of 9/11 and the toll it left on the U.S. 25 years later. And, President Trump and Vice President Vance's convention speeches urge voters to back the GOP in the midterms.
item.content:encoded:
NPR reflects on the events of 9/11 and the toll it left on the U.S. 25 years later. And, President Trump and Vice President Vance's convention speeches urge voters to back the GOP in the midterms.

(Image credit: Leonardo Munoz)

item.title: 25 years later, Americans pause to remember the lives lost on 9/11
item.description: Twenty-five years ago, nearly 3,000 people were killed in the 9/11 attacks. Today, Americans are honoring the lives lost and reflecting on the aftermath of that tragic day.
item.content:encoded: Twenty-five years ago, nearly 3,000 people were killed in the 9/11 attacks. Today, Americans are honoring the lives lost and reflecting on the aftermath of that tragic day.

item.title: John Avlon, Rudy Giuliani's chief speechwriter during 9/11 attacks, recounts that day
item.description: NPR's Michel Martin asks John Avlon, who was chief speechwriter to New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani at the time of the 9/11 attacks, for his memories of that day.

item.title: They cleaned up ground zero. Now many are hiding from ICE
item.description: After 9/11, thousands of rescue and cleanup crews went to work at ground zero. They were exposed to toxic debris and experienced psychological trauma. Today, many say they live in fear of deportation.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Empty seats, socialism and Trump dominate the Republican midterm convention
item.description: The two day Republican convention in Dallas showcased the party's biggest asset in trying to win competitive midterm races and its greatest obstacle: President Trump.

item.title: Trump administration allows TPS to continue for Salvadorans – for now
item.description: The Trump administration declined this week to terminate TPS for Salvadorans, even though it has done so for people from other countries like Haiti and Syria. But it also hasn't said whether it will extend the protection in the future.

item.title: On the 25th anniversary of 9/11, a divided U.S. gathers to remember and grieve
item.description: The U.S. marks the 25th anniversary of 9/11. Events will honor those lost, at a time when Americans are divided about the meaning and legacy of the terrorist attacks.

item.title: Morning Edition hosts recount their experience covering 9/11 in D.C. and New York
item.description: Morning Edition hosts Steve Inskeep and Michel Martin both reported from the Sept. 11 terror attack sites. Steve recalls reporting outside the Pentagon and Michel recounts her time in lower Manhattan.
